title: Introduction to React Redux
overview: React Redux is the official library that connects Redux with React applications. It provides hooks and components to access and update Redux state.

example.title: React Redux Purpose
example.content:
React App
 ↓
React Redux
 ↓
Redux Store

title: Installing React Redux
overview: React Redux is installed as a package and provides APIs required to connect React components with Redux.

title: Provider in React Redux
overview: Provider is a React component that makes the Redux store available throughout the component tree.

title: useSelector Hook
overview: useSelector allows React components to read data from the Redux store.

title: useDispatch Hook
overview: useDispatch allows components to send actions to Redux reducers and update the store.

title: React Redux Data Flow
overview: React Redux creates a connection between UI components and Redux state using a predictable one-way data flow.

example.title: Data Flow
example.content:
Component
 ↓
useDispatch()
 ↓
Reducer
 ↓
Store
 ↓
useSelector()
 ↓
Component

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned about React Redux, Provider, useSelector, useDispatch, and how React communicates with Redux.
